purpose: Selection rule for the V7 experimental Lumen recipe, declared before the F1 and asymmetric-calibration results exist.
candidates: asymmetric-target variant, only if its 12-layer pilot beats the symmetric pilot by >= 3 % on P-A108-dev without being worse on select
equal_budget: same bytes as Arki05 2.82 bpw for the 498 text matrices (9.456 GB); F1 is measured on real files
primary_metric: token-mean KL on P-A108-dev (54 of the 108 public Arki05 windows, alternating rows per domain)
guards: no P-A108-dev domain more than 10 % above Arki05_2.82bpw
rule: lowest primary metric among candidates that pass all guards
confirmation: sealed P-A108-conf half (54 windows), written at variant creation, never printed
conf2: 300 new documents x 1024 tokens (data/conf2), never evaluated before
development_data_already_consulted: full P-A108 for Arki05, XQD and L0 (measured before the dev/conf split was introduced)
